messages:
violet: Kickoff for multi-cloud marketplace onboarding. Need aligned packaging across AWS/GCP/Azure: SKUs, brief descriptions, support contact, and legal links. Timeline: submit AWS by Fri, GCP/Azure next week.

owen: I'll map SKUs and ensure naming parity across clouds. Suggest prefix RW-MKT-<OFFER>-<PLAN>.

dina: product copy here  short blurb draft: "Redwood Inference  fast, reliable LLM inference for production. Try 30 days free." Is "Try" ok with marketplace rules?

priya: Legal prefers "Includes a 30-day trial" instead of "Try". Also need EULA + DPA links for each listing.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: GCP listing requires product icons in PNG 128x128 and a one-line short description under 200 chars. Docs: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/docs/listing

owen: I'll prepare a canonical CSV with columns: cloud,sku,offer_name,plan,term,price,contact_email,legal_links. Uploading to partnerships/marketplace-assets/multi-cloud-skus.csv

violet: Support contact: marketplace-support@redwood.ai. Sam_k from growth will draft co-marketing blurb.

sam_k: I can craft a 1-line promo for marketplace banners. Will avoid promotional language like discounts per legal.

legal: EULA https://legal.redwood.ai/eula-v2 , DPA https://legal.redwood.ai/dpa-v1. Confirmed: use "Includes a 30-day trial" and no SLA claims for hosted offerings. If Dedicated listing mentions SLA, attach SLA doc.

dina: Copy updated: "Redwood Inference  predictable, high-performance LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Includes a 30-day trial."

owen: CSV uploaded v0.1. Example row: 
aws,RW-MKT-AWS-HOSTED-TRIAL,Hosted API,Trial,30d,0,marketplace-support@redwood.ai,https://legal.redwood.ai/eula-v2|https://legal.redwood.ai/dpa-v1

marketplace-bot: AWS checklist status: images missing, pricing model details missing. GCP checklist status: icon missing, short description missing. Azure checklist status: metadata incomplete.

violet: Laura/marketing please export hero 1024x512 and icon 128x128 for GCP. Also need retina logo 512x512 for Azure.

priya: Also confirm data residency note for EU customers in the listing descriptions where relevant. Add `Data residency: EU available` to Dedicated entries only.

owen: Adding a column `notes` in the CSV for data residency and tax flags.

sam_k: I'll coordinate with marketing to supply copy variants for US vs EU marketplace pages.

violet: Plan: finish assets + CSV today, submit AWS staging tomorrow AM. GCP/Azure follow-up next week. If any blockers, DM me. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
